each unit in the preset's order; a layer unit once a layer

svg.text: when the sun moves: thread commands of their own, before the next FRAME
sun (direct.shadow_pcf): a DEPTH view a quadrant of the map, through the same units: the opaque
and masked layers' raster, SHADE's masked merge of 1/z, then COPY of 1/z into light.shadow_map.
update (indirect.field_update, in gi): the sources from light.shadow_map, a bounce pass an apply of
indirect.transport (elements.radiance in, elements.irradiance out), the field's pages into light.field;
field_scale gives light.field_scale to the host, which writes LIGHT's table. Then the next FRAME.
a layer's work on the cores
Every core runs every stage's handlers: one program. A DEPTH view runs the layers whose depth column is set,
and LIGHT does nothing in it. The slots are those of each implementation's declaration (src/prism/stages).
